title: nl-offline: "Primary statement" covers only NCSC.NL
description: The Rijksoverheid capture names only NCSC.NL; DigiD, MijnOverheid and Overheid.nl are not in it, and dutchitleaders-websites-offline is a Cloudflare challenge (75 chars). Status "confirmed" with note "Primary statement" overstates three of the four services. Cite tpo-nl-digid-offline and insurancebusiness-uk-councils-met (DigiD, MijnOverheid) and reuters-factbox-websites-offline (Overheid.nl), and mark those parts reported.
